title: The Spring of Gu
lines: Fang Yuan opened his eyes. Before him stretched the vast Gu Master Academy of Qing Mao Mountain. He was fifteen again — a young slave just beginning his cultivation. But his eyes held the knowledge of five hundred years.
'Five hundred years,' he whispered, looking at his youthful hands. The last thing he remembered was the Immortal Gu exploding in his face, consuming his body and soul. And now... he was back.

The Spring of Gu flowed before him, its waters dark and shimmering with primal energy. In this world, Gu Masters cultivated by refining malevolent insects — living weapons raised in vats of blood and spirit energy. Power was measured not in virtue, but in the cruelty of your Gu.
'Fang Yuan! Stop daydreaming and fetch my tea!' The voice of his master, a petty third-rank Gu Master who had tormented him in his first life. Fang Yuan had tolerated the abuse then. Not this time.

He poured the tea — and added a single drop of a rank-one sleeping Gu he had refined in secret during his weeks of preparation. The master collapsed. Fang Yuan walked out of the academy, never to return. He had five centuries of wars, betrayals, and near-immortality to draw upon. The world was his for the taking.
